question: Could you assess the relationship between the poverty rates from the previous year's census data and the percentage of births without maternal morbidity for the years 2016 to 2018? Use only data for births where no maternal morbidity was reported and for each year, use the 5-year census data from the year before to compute the Pearson correlation coefficient
sql:
-- Compute Pearson correlation for each year using CORR function
WITH natality AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year) as year,
    County_of_Residence_FIPS as fips,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Maternal_Morbidity_Desc = 'None checked' THEN Births ELSE 0 END) as births_no_morbidity,
    SUM(Births) as total_births
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_maternal_morbidity`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year) BETWEEN 2016 AND 2018
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year), County_of_Residence_FIPS
),
census_2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    geo_id as fips,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) * 100 as poverty_rate_pct
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2015_5yr`
  WHERE poverty IS NOT NULL AND pop_determined_poverty_status IS NOT NULL AND pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
census_2016 AS (
  SELECT 
    geo_id as fips,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) * 100 as poverty_rate_pct
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2016_5yr`
  WHERE poverty IS NOT NULL AND pop_determined_poverty_status IS NOT NULL AND pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
census_2017 AS (
  SELECT 
    geo_id as fips,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) * 100 as poverty_rate_pct
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2017_5yr`
  WHERE poverty IS NOT NULL AND pop_determined_poverty_status IS NOT NULL AND pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
joined AS (
  SELECT n.year, n.fips, 
         SAFE_DIVIDE(n.births_no_morbidity, n.total_births) * 100 as pct_no_morbidity,
         CASE n.year
           WHEN 2016 THEN c2015.poverty_rate_pct
           WHEN 2017 THEN c2016.poverty_rate_pct
           WHEN 2018 THEN c2017.poverty_rate_pct
         END as poverty_rate_pct
  FROM natality n
  LEFT JOIN census_2015 c2015 ON n.fips = c2015.fips AND n.year = 2016
  LEFT JOIN census_2016 c2016 ON n.fips = c2016.fips AND n.year = 2017
  LEFT JOIN census_2017 c2017 ON n.fips = c2017.fips AND n.year = 2018
  WHERE n.total_births > 0
    AND CASE n.year
           WHEN 2016 THEN c2015.poverty_rate_pct
           WHEN 2017 THEN c2016.poverty_rate_pct
           WHEN 2018 THEN c2017.poverty_rate_pct
         END IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  year,
  CORR(pct_no_morbidity, poverty_rate_pct) as pearson_correlation,
  COUNT(*) as num_counties
FROM joined
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year
